title: Apply Capstone: Release Confidence Plan
prompt: Deliver and partially implement the complete Release Confidence Plan with layer map, critical journeys, data, device matrix, flake policy, CI schedule, artifacts, exclusions, and acceptance criteria.
successCriteria: The check names the risk, observable promise, and fidelity requirement.
Time, data, asynchronous work, external state, and cleanup are deterministic.
Failure artifacts, execution trigger, owner, and intentional blind spots are documented.
hints: Move the check down a layer until any further move would lose necessary fidelity.
Make the intended regression fail before trusting the new evidence.

starterCode.code:
data class QualityGate(val risk:String,val evidence:String,val trigger:Trigger,val owner:Team,val blocksRelease:Boolean)
val plan:List<QualityGate> = criticalRisks.map(::designCheapestEvidence)

solutionOutline: Model the risk, select the environment, and control all relevant variables.
Assert behaviour, inject adverse cases, capture diagnostics, and document operations.
verification: Repeat in random order and isolation to prove determinism.
Introduce the target defect and confirm the check fails with an actionable report.
